review_notes: I read the whole target file. I also read the Foundation definitions and simp attributes for quadraticModel, SemijetRemainder and HasSecondOrderExpansion*, the TestFunctions/Characterization quadraticModel lemmas, and downstream uses of the Superjet/Subjet congruence lemmas, the Excess definitions and the iff lemmas. I did not run Lean. The congruence lemmas are used as instantiated simp rewrites (`simpa [superjet_congr_nhdsWithin hnhds]`), which is fine, so I report nothing there. I found no simp loop and no direction problem. quadraticModel_add and quadraticModel_sub are deliberately not simp, since a simp rewrite would split sums, so I flag nothing there. I report two modest gaps: the missing value-shift/center simp interface for quadraticModel, and the missing Excess equation lemmas. Both depend on the unseen simp normal form and are suggestions, not observed failures.

findings.problem: quadraticModel has no value-shift or center simp interface, so proofs fully unfold the definition with `simp [quadraticModel]` and then call `ring`. The goal compares `quadraticModel x0 (φ x0) …` with `quadraticModel x0 (u x0) …`. The only change is the value argument, so this is unwanted expansion into dotProduct/mulVec terms. The same unfold-and-ring pattern appears at line 343. Foundation has `quadraticModel_neg` as a simp lemma. The center lemma `quadraticModel_center` lives in the later TestFunctions/Characterization.lean and is not simp. Foundation itself proves the same fact with `simp [quadraticModel]`.
findings.proposed_change: In Foundation.lean next to `quadraticModel_neg`, add a lemma stating `quadraticModel x0 (r + s) p X x = quadraticModel x0 r p X x + s`. Also add `@[simp] theorem quadraticModel_center` there, moved from Characterization.lean. Then rewrite the two touch proofs as `rw [hφx, ...]; ring`, with no unfolding of `quadraticModel`. The value-shift lemma is probably best kept non-simp, used via `rw`, or stated with `r - s` so it does not loop.
findings.benefit: The simp set can rewrite the base-point value without exposing dotProduct/mulVec internals. The touch proofs, and the many other `simp [quadraticModel]` sites (74 across 25 files), would stay robust if the definition of `quadraticModel` changes.

findings.problem: The two Excess definitions have no unfolding or relating equation lemmas. SubjetExcess is definitionally the negation of SuperjetExcess (`q - u` versus `u - q`), but no lemma states this. Every consumer therefore unfolds the definitions by hand: `unfold SuperjetExcess` or `unfold SubjetExcess` six times in this file (lines 111–205), and `simp only [SuperjetExcess, …]` in Normalization.lean and JetTransfer.lean. The sub/super lemmas and the continuity and difference-jet proofs are duplicated line for line.
findings.proposed_change: Add the lemma `SubjetExcess u x J y = -SuperjetExcess u x J y`. Optionally mark it @[simp] if one normal form (the negated SuperjetExcess) is preferred, and keep the one-sided lemmas as corollaries. Also add unfolding lemmas that downstream `simp only` calls can cite, e.g. `superjetExcess_def` as `rfl`, instead of unfolding the definitions at each use. Whether the simp-normal-form direction suits the downstream sites depends on code I did not run, so keep it non-simp if unsure.
findings.benefit: The Sub* variants of continuity, the difference-jet identity and the nonpositivity transfer could follow from the Super* ones. That removes duplicated proofs and gives downstream block-coordinate arguments one canonical form for the excess.
